updated the name
Why are these optional?

This is a common API used to extract and validate source and destination record details.
In some use cases (for example, during refactoring of updateKeywordOnPrimaryOrBackupPath), the requirement is only to extract the record details, and no VPD maps are available or required for validation.

To support both extraction-only and extraction-with-validation flows using the same API, the source and destination VPD maps are defined as std::optional.

In that case, IMO, 
The name of the function is misleading?
If there will be no map then how it will extract and find in "map"?



Better name or further split those functionalities?

Agreed. The previous name was misleading. I have renamed the API to better reflect its responsibility and updated the Doxygen to clearly document that validation against the VPD map is only performed when a map is provided. This should make the behaviour and intent of the function clear without splitting the functionality.
